thread:
maya: Heads up — OrionCloud flagged a split shipment and a marketplace SKU mismatch. One rack shipped, rest delayed 6–8 weeks due to port congestion. This will affect several Dedicated reservations in EU‑west and APAC. PO 48291 shows a partial ship and some reservations routed to SKU-RCXL vs SKU-RC-XL-80 (duplicate listing). Need triage and quick mitigation.
jordan: Do we have the PO and carrier tracking? Which reservations are impacted?
maya: PO: ```48291``` Carrier: OceanicTrans AWB 557-889-01 (first rack). Partner portal: https://portal.orioncloud.example.com/shipments/48291 — notes show ‘‘partial release — remaining units hold pending berth''.
samir: Any estimate on lost GPU capacity for the week of Apr 8? Can we reshuffle within Dedicated pools without breaching isolation?
liam: Ballpark: ~12 GPUs short in eu-west dedicated pools, ~8 in apac — ~15% throughput hit for small Dedicated customers. We might be able to reassign soft reservations to eu-central or offer hosted fallbacks.
elaine: We have two onboarding customers with SLA start dates next week. Need to flag CS & Sales now. Can we offer temporary hosted credits or prioritized US deployments?
supply-bot: Reservation ledger updated: moved 5 reservations from eu-west to eu-central (soft-failover). See /reservations/4621 for details.
jordan: Can eng-platform patch routing to prefer eu-central for those reservations? @samir can you take the override?
samir: I can add a routing override, but need the reservation UUIDs and confirmation of which customers to exclude. I'll throttle the autoscaler to avoid cascading reprovisioning.
maya: Affected reservations (UUIDs): ```res-8a3f, res-8a4b, res-9c01, res-9c02, res-9c05``` — excluding enterprise-corp-1 and securebank (they need physical isolation).
liam: Procurement can try an airfreight for critical racks — cost ~3x, ETA ~5 days if approved. Also negotiating partial credit with OrionCloud for the delay.
elaine: I'll draft a customer-facing note (high level). Want to avoid logistics details but offer options: 1) temporary hosted fallback, 2) prioritized eu-central placement, 3) extended onboarding window + credit. @jordan can we toggle fallback model to quantized smaller instance types for these routes?
jordan: Yes, we can enable fallback to quantized variants in hosted for specific routes — latency might increase but preserves capacity. Need explicit list of routes to flip.
maya: Decision needed by EOD. Plan proposal: (A) remap soft reservations to eu-central, (B) enable hosted fallback for affected routes, (C) notify CS + offer credits, (D) approve airfreight for 2 critical racks. @liam escalate airfreight quote.
liam: :thumbsup: Kicking off airfreight quote with carrier now. Will update ETA and cost in this thread.
samir: Routing override applied for the listed reservations. Autoscaler paused for 2 hours on affected pools. I'll post metrics to the ops dashboard.
supply-bot: Carrier update — first rack delivered 2024-03-22T10:47Z. Remaining units Estimated: 2024-04-30 (subject to change).
elaine: Thanks. I'll post the customer note in #customer-success and flag the two onboarding accounts for manual support.
maya: Good work team. Keep updates here. If airfreight is approved, we’ll revert the soft remap for enterprise-corp-1 and securebank only once racks are on-site.
